title: Deepa Jewellers IPO Details
intro:
Deepa Jewellers IPO is a book build issue of ₹459.72 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 1.41 crore shares aggregating to ₹250.00 crores and offer for sale of 1.18 crore shares aggregating to ₹209.72 crores.

Deepa Jewellers IPO opens for subscription on Sep 1, 2026 and closes on Sep 3, 2026. The allotment for the Deepa Jewellers IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 4, 2026. Deepa Jewellers IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 8, 2026.

Deepa Jewellers IPO is set issue price band at ₹168 to ₹177 per share. The lot size for an application is 84 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,868 (84 shares) (based on upper price).

Emkay Global Financial Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Deepa Jewellers IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2016, Deepa Jewellers Ltd. is engaged in the retail and wholesale trading of gold and diamond jewellery, offering a wide range of traditional and contemporary designs catering to diverse customer preferences. The company focuses on sourcing, designing, and selling jewellery products including rings, necklaces, earrings, bangles, and customized ornaments crafted with quality materials and skilled workmanship.

Product Portfolio: Vaddanam (waist belt), CNC machine cut bangles, gents kada, vanky(armlet), dandpatti (bajuband), gundlamala haaram (traditional neck piece), gundlamala necklace, kangan, earring, mangtika (forehead pendant), maatil (ear chain), champasaralu (ear to hair chain), jada (braid ornament), and rings.

Deepa Jewellers Ltd. emphasizes purity, transparent pricing, and customer trust, operating through physical stores and distribution channels while adhering to regulatory standards and evolving jewellery market trends.

As of July 31, 2026, the company's customer network spans across 13 states and 1 union territory in India with a total customer base of 373 customers, comprising of 47 jewellery retail chains and 326 standalone stores.

The company use third-party mobile application namely “Deepa Jewellers Limited” to enhance their brand visibility, disseminate information and display product collections, which was commissioned by them on June 25, 2021. This application enables access to high-resolution images of selected jewellery designs to remote customers.
As on July 31, 2026, they have a product portfolio of 16 products and 110 SKUs across their product categories.
strengths: Diverse product portfolio with varied weight ranges, designs and specialisation in vadannam and CNC machine cut bangles
Established procurement network and long -standing relationship with karigars
Well experienced Promoters and a professional management team with sectoral experience

faqs.question: How to apply in Deepa Jewellers IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Deepa Jewellers IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Deepa Jewellers IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Deepa Jewellers IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Deepa Jewellers IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Deepa Jewellers IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Deepa Jewellers IPO opens on Tue, Sep 1, 2026 and closes on Thu, Sep 3, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Deepa Jewellers IPO?
faqs.answer: Deepa Jewellers IPO lot size is 84 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,868 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Deepa Jewellers IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Deepa Jewellers IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Deepa Jewellers IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Deepa Jewellers IPO will be done on Friday, September 4, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 7, 2026 . Check the Deepa Jewellers IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Deepa Jewellers IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Deepa Jewellers IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 8, 2026 .
